Summaries.Author: Keith O'Hara (OptimLib) / SMath Studio Wrapper
Summaries.Description: An SMath Studio plugin wrapping OptimLib's optimisation algorithms (BFGS, L-BFGS, CG, GD, Newton, Nelder-Mead, DE, PSO, SUMT, Broyden) for user-defined worksheet expressions and functions, including box-bounded global search (DE/PSO), constrained problems and residual systems. All values are unitless.
Summaries.Title: Optim Wrapper
